applied_caps.explanation: Global retries of 3 with no first-attempt metric can turn intermittent failures green; this caps the overall at 4 and lowers it from 4.5.
Reliability scored 3 (fixed sleeps, shared user); the cap of 5 does not bind because the overall is already lower.
The suite was not run and no reports were supplied; static inspection caps the overall at 8 (does not bind).

dimensions.name: Test effectiveness
dimensions.finding: Core happy paths are represented, but failure-path depth is limited.
risks: Payment rejection regressions may pass unnoticed
recommendations: Add rejection, timeout, duplicate-submit, and recovery scenarios

dimensions.name: Suite trustworthiness
dimensions.finding: Global retries and weak assertions create material false-pass risk.
risks: Intermittent defects may be reported as passing
recommendations: Track first-run failures separately and remove broad retries

dimensions.name: Reliability and determinism
dimensions.finding: Fixed sleeps and a shared test user make execution order-sensitive.
recommendations: Use condition waits and per-test users

dimensions.name: Test design and level selection
dimensions.finding: Most checks run end to end through the browser [e1]; a few API-level tests cover pricing rules cheaply [e2].

evidence.text: npm test -- --list: 71 of 84 listed tests are in tests/e2e/
tests/api/pricing.spec.ts calls the pricing endpoint directly

risks: Slow feedback for rules that an API test could check
recommendations: Move validation-rule checks from e2e to API tests

dimensions.name: Assertion and oracle quality
dimensions.finding: Many tests assert only that a page loaded or a toast appeared, not the resulting order or balance.
evidence: tests/checkout.spec.ts asserts toBeVisible() on the confirmation banner only
19 tests end with a URL check
risks: Wrong totals or duplicate orders would pass
recommendations: Assert the order record and amounts, not only the banner

dimensions.name: Test scope and coverage
dimensions.finding: Behavioural breadth is moderate; instrumented code coverage was not measurable.
evidence: No application source or coverage report supplied
recommendations: Publish source-linked coverage or an API specification

dimensions.name: Isolation and state management
dimensions.finding: All tests sign in as one shared user and reuse its basket; no teardown removes created orders.
evidence: fixtures/user.ts exports a single shared account
No afterEach or cleanup hook in tests/
recommendations: Create a user per test and clean up created orders

dimensions.name: Maintainability and appropriate reuse
dimensions.finding: Page objects are thin and readable; selectors mix data-testid with CSS chains.
evidence: pages/ holds 9 page objects under 80 lines each

dimensions.name: CI/CD integration
dimensions.finding: A workflow runs the suite on pull requests, but no run history was supplied to show it gates merges.
recommendations: Make the e2e job a required check

dimensions.name: Debuggability and reporting
dimensions.finding: Traces are kept on first retry only, and the HTML report is not uploaded as an artifact.
risks: CI failures are hard to diagnose
recommendations: Upload the report and traces on failure

dimensions.name: Performance and feedback speed
dimensions.finding: Not assessed: the suite was not run and no timings were supplied.

dimensions.name: Test data management
dimensions.finding: Product and price data are hard-coded and depend on the staging catalogue.
evidence: tests/checkout.spec.ts hard-codes SKU and price literals
recommendations: Seed products through the API per run

dimensions.name: Environment portability and realism
dimensions.finding: Base URL comes from an environment variable, but prerequisites are undocumented.
risks: New contributors cannot run the suite
recommendations: Document the environment and credentials needed

dimensions.name: Security, privacy, accessibility, compatibility
dimensions.finding: Not assessed: no security, accessibility or cross-browser checks were found to judge, and no requirements say which apply.

dimensions.name: Ownership and operational discipline
dimensions.finding: Not assessed: no ownership, triage or skip-expiry information was supplied.

critical_findings.title: Retries can mask first-run failures
critical_findings.impact: A green build may not represent deterministic behaviour.

recommendations.title: Stop retries hiding first-run failures
recommendations.action: Set retries to 0 on pull requests, keep at most 1 on the nightly run, and report first-attempt failures as their own metric.
acceptance_criteria: playwright.config.ts uses retries 0 when CI runs for a pull request
The CI summary lists tests that passed only on retry

recommendations.title: Eliminate shared mutable test state
recommendations.action: Create unique users and order data per test, then enable parallel execution in CI.
acceptance_criteria: Four parallel workers complete without collisions

recommendations.title: Strengthen negative-path assertions
recommendations.action: Add explicit rejection, timeout, and recovery scenarios with state and side-effect assertions.
acceptance_criteria: Each critical flow has positive and negative scenarios
Failures identify the incorrect business outcome

recommendations.title: Replace fixed sleeps with condition waits
recommendations.action: Replace the 27 waitForTimeout calls with expect(...).toBeVisible() or waitForResponse on the request the step depends on.
acceptance_criteria: The suite passes three consecutive runs with no retries

recommendations.title: Upload the report and traces on failure
recommendations.action: Add an upload-artifact step for playwright-report/ and test-results/ that runs if: failure(), and record traces with retain-on-failure.
acceptance_criteria: A failed CI run has the HTML report and a trace attached

recommendations.title: Move validation rules below the browser
recommendations.action: Test pricing and form-validation rules through the API, keeping a few end-to-end journeys per critical flow.
acceptance_criteria: Validation-rule checks run as API tests
The end-to-end layer keeps one journey per critical flow

recommendations.title: Supply run results, CI history and the application's specification
recommendations.action: Provide a staging environment and credentials to run the suite twice, the last 30 CI runs with retry counts, and the API specification or application source.
acceptance_criteria: Reliability, performance and operational health can be scored from execution evidence
Behavioural coverage can be checked against a specification
